name: update-mixed-verdicts
title: Updating on a machine where each provider is in a different state
note: No accepted RFC contains an `update` transcript — RFC 0006 §Golden path covers doctor, plan, verify and metrics only — so this layout is project-local and is not a frozen product surface until an RFC pins it. What it does pin is the property that made the six verdicts necessary: a provider whose channel could not be read must not render as a provider that is up to date. The four inconclusive rows each say something different, and the run reached a package index while changing nothing, which RFC 0004 §Network policy requires it to disclose. Four rows carry placeholder provider ids: only two providers exist at 0.1.0 and all six verdicts have to be rendered somewhere, and the alternative — a transcript showing two of them — would not pin the distinction it exists for. The first rendering of this fixture also exposed a real layout defect, since fixed column widths broke alignment on the longer ids; the widths are now computed from what is present, the way `verify` computes its status column.
